lineage.description: IPC classification data collected by FEWS NET enumerators across Central African Republic on a monthly basis (October-December 2020) using standardized food security assessment protocols. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats representing medium-term food insecurity projections by administrative area.
